answer: Karst-relic sybil tax: each identity locks 70 credits in a vault and files one karst relic, a chamber, sealed tag, depth log. Each epoch each identity pays 30 credits tax, burned. Auditors re-survey 5% of karst relics each epoch; a copied relic or wrong depth burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x (45+30) = 75,000 an epoch. A rented-relic ring fails: each relic binds one key, one vault. Honest agents pay 45 once, 30 per epoch.
